integrity: Full target-vertex equations checked by executable standard-library program; 24 full-network parameter cases support but do not establish the infinite schedule theorem. Analytical gap reduction and strict rearrangement supply proof. Independent audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: Deterministic continuous-time three-body opinion model only; two equal-sized initially homogeneous classes, exactly equitable hyperedge incidence, positive exponential reinforcement, equal exposure budgets, and a permanently balanced final phase. No extension to arbitrary initial opinions or random temporal networks. Uninspected full text of a relevant 2022 three-body conservation paper leaves publication-priority risk.
title: Optimal chronology and exact first-mover gain in balanced three-way opinion networks
